adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` the refresh flow still calls Salesforce directly (`fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token"...)`) and does not use `refreshOAuthTokens`. Yet it validates the response via `parseRefreshTokenResponse(accessTokenJson, salesforceTokenSchema)`. `parseRefreshTokenResponse` switches to `minimumTokenResponseSchema` whenever `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`), which is a global toggle unrelated to Salesforce. This means enabling credential sharing/sync for other apps changes Salesforce’s validation path and can either weaken validation (no longer enforcing `salesforceTokenSchema`) or even break refresh if the minimum schema doesn’t match Salesforce’s token response. That inconsistent boundary is directly evidenced by the diff.
